PdfImport.Title: Import Rulebook PDF
PdfImport.MenuHint: Read your own copy of a Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG book into this world: gear, spells, Mobs, achievements and maps.
PdfImport.PickHint: Pick your own copy of a Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG book. It is read in your browser; nothing is uploaded except map images, which are saved to your Foundry Data folder.
PdfImport.GMOnly: Only the GM can import a rulebook.
PdfImport.ResultsHint: Found in {title}. Everything goes into folders named after the book; importing the same book again updates those documents instead of copying them, except ones you've edited since.
PdfImport.MapsHint: Pages that look like maps are checked. Uncheck any that are art, or check any the importer missed.
PdfImport.SummarySkipped: ({skipped} skipped: edited since the last import)
PdfImport.SkippedEdited: Not overwritten because you've edited them since the last import (delete one and import again to refresh it): {names}
PdfImport.NoWebp: This browser cannot save WebP images.

Toolbox.Title: GM Toolbox
Toolbox.GMOnly: Only the GM can open the GM Toolbox.
Toolbox.ResolveTwoHourPickerPrompt: Choose who played these 2 hours. Each gains 1 Level, and their marked Skills at Rank 4 or lower roll Advancement Checks (Rank 5+ waits for End Floor).
Toolbox.EndFloorHint: Rank 5+ Advancement Checks, erase all marks, end-of-floor Popularity, then go to the next Floor.
Toolbox.EndFloorPickerPrompt: Choose who is descending. Their marked Skills at Rank 5+ roll Advancement Checks, all marks are erased, and Popularity changes by their Charisma. The Floor then advances by 1.

EndFloorReminder.Cooldowns: "Once per Floor" and "once per X days" cooldowns reset.
EndFloorReminder.Popularity: Other end-of-floor Popularity calls (p.280): +1 for a cute Pet moment or a memorable catchphrase; -1 for a boring d10+ main Attack, entering the stairwell 30+ hours early, or grinding 15+ of the final 30 hours.
EndFloorReminder.Boxes: Fan Box for high performers (one per Floor); a Benefactor Box if they have a Sponsor (once per Floor).
EndFloorReminder.RaceClass: Race/Class end-of-floor features, e.g. Human's or Hobgoblin's extra Advancement Check with Advantage.
EndFloorReminder.Collapse: Floor {floor} collapses in {days} days (30-hour days) unless you set your own.
EndFloorReminder.CollapseCustom: Set Floor {floor}'s collapse timer and announce it.

Toolbox.BossKilledHint: Award Levels for a Boss kill by its tier (p.170).
Toolbox.BossKilledPickerPrompt: Choose the party members who gain the Levels.
Toolbox.MendHint: Each full hour outside combat or stress: +1 HB slot and +5 Mana (p.95). Advances the world clock.
Toolbox.MendPickerPrompt: Choose who spent these hours mending.
Toolbox.TwoHourReachedBody: The Play Timer has reached 2 hours. Resolve the 2-Hour Tick (Advancement Checks and +1 Level) whenever you're ready - this does not happen automatically.

Rest.PickerPrompt: Choose which characters rest. Not everyone has to - someone could be on watch or otherwise occupied.

Toolbox.RestAppliedNone: No characters were selected - no rest was applied.
Toolbox.GrindThresholdReached: {name} has accrued enough hours - rolling a Skill Advancement Check.
Toolbox.LootNoItemTypeTable: Could not find the "Item Type" table in the Roll Tables compendium.

Actor.AiFavorHint: Spend 1 to reroll a d20 (not a Nat 1) or, once per round, take an extra non-Attack Action (p.61).
Actor.StatPointsRemainingHint: Computed fresh from this Mob's Level and Tier - see the Spend Stat Points dialog for the exact formula.
Actor.BonusFromItemsSkills: Bonus from items/skills, applied on top of the base value
Actor.SurpriseHint: 10 + INT Mod, +Floor at time of use (p.271) - not baked in, since Floor can change without this Mob being re-saved.
Actor.EvadeHint: 10 + DEX Mod, +Floor at time of use (p.271) - the Difficulty crawlers' attacks must beat to hit this Mob.
Actor.HbSlotsOverrideHint: Leave blank to use the computed Level/Tier formula (shown as a placeholder); set a number to override it.
Actor.ResistanceGrantedHint: Overridden by an owned item's Resistance grant
Actor.SlotGearOnly: Only gear can go in a gear or accessory slot.

DamageEffect.ParentSkillsHint: Attack Skills this Damage Effect can be selected for at attack time.

SkillChoice.Hint: "+X in a [category] Skill of your choice" - authored here without a fixed target; the owner picks a real Skill below, which materializes a permanent Change on this item.
SkillChoice.PickPlaceholder: Type or pick a Skill name
SkillChoice.NeedName: Type a Skill name before assigning this grant.

Ranked.DamageTypeSplit: Damage Type Split (once unlocked, overrides/splits the default damage pool)

Change.TargetSkillPlaceholder: Type or pick a Skill/Spell name
Change.Label: Label

Chat.NoGMOnline: No GM is currently connected to apply this action.

TargetEffects.NoTargets: No targets were selected when this roll was made.

Damage.DyingCountdown: {name} is Dying: the hit takes 1 off the countdown instead ({rounds} round(s) left).
Damage.NoTargets: No targets were selected when this roll was made.

Heal.BlockedByDebuff: {name} has {debuff} and can't be healed. Remove the Debuff first to apply this healing.
Heal.Subtitle: +{amount} HB
Heal.WillHeal: Heals {amount} Health Bar slot(s) when applied.
Heal.WillHealFull: Heals to full and grants the benefits of a Short Rest when applied.
Heal.NoActor: The caster for this heal could no longer be found.
Heal.NoConditions: {name} has no active Conditions to mend.

Evade.FreeEvadeFailedBody: The Attack still lands unless they spend an Action to Evade again with Roll Evade on the Attack card.
Evade.NoBaseDamage: The original Attack rolled no damage to apply.
Evade.NoActor: Could not find the defending actor for this card.

Targets.EvadeCriticalFail: Evade Critical Fail - hit, double damage
Targets.ApplyFromCard: Apply the result from this target's row on the Attack card.
Targets.EvadePending: Evade rolled - waiting for the GM to record it
Targets.ImmuneNoEffects: {name} is immune to this damage, so its Debuffs don't apply (p.93).
Targets.OldCard: This Attack card is from an older version - re-roll the Attack to get per-target Evade buttons.

Consumable.Title: Consumable
Consumable.PotionHint: Applies to the one targeted token, or else the user. A Potion counts toward Potion Sickness (more than one every other round in combat); other items don't.
Consumable.PerRoundHint: Restored at the end of each combat round while the Buff lasts. A Buff measured in rounds ends after that many round ends, and with the combat.

SpellHint.scroll: Casts the Spell once at this Rank with no Mana, then turns to dust. Blank fields are read from a name like "Scroll of Magic Missile (Rank 3)".
SpellHint.spellbook: Teaches the Spell at this Rank (blank: 1d6-1, minimum 1), then disappears. Blank fields are read from a name like "Spellbook of Hole (Rank 2)".

Consumable.ChooseRecipient: {name} is targeted. Use {item} yourself, or give it to them?
Consumable.SpellbookKnown: {name} already knows {spell} at Rank {rank} - this book can't teach more. It's kept.
Consumable.ChooseSkillHint: Choose the Skill this potion raises.
Consumable.NoRecipient: Whoever this was for no longer exists.
Consumable.ApplyFailed: Couldn't apply it - see the console. Apply is still available to try again.
Consumable.NoStat: {item} doesn't say which Stat it raises - set it on the item.
Consumable.NoDuration: {item} restores something each round but doesn't say for how long - set its Buff's duration.
Consumable.SkillAtCap: {name}'s {skill} is already as high as it can go - the potion is kept.

LimitReached.stat: {name} has already drunk two Stat potions - the most a crawler ever can.
LimitReached.skill: {name} has already drunk two Skill potions - the most a crawler ever can.

Consumable.NoSpell: {item}: couldn't find the Spell "{spell}" - link it on the item.
Consumable.NoRank: {item} doesn't say its Rank - set it on the item.
Consumable.ScrollCast: Cast from a scroll at Rank {rank} - no Mana

Does.MendAny: Mends one Minor or Major Injury

Result.HealedAtOnce: {name} heals {slots} Health Bar slots from {buff} - all at once, outside a fight.
Result.ManaAtOnce: {name} regains {amount} Mana from {buff} - all at once, outside a fight.
Result.SkillAtCap: {name}'s {skill} is already at its highest Rank ({rank}) - nothing gained.
Result.CrawlersOnly: Only a crawler can gain a permanent boost - {name} gets nothing from it.

LimitReached.stat: {name} has already drunk two Stat potions - this one does nothing.
LimitReached.skill: {name} has already drunk two Skill potions - this one does nothing.

Result.Sickness: Potion Sickness: {name} drank another potion within two rounds and is Poisoned until the end of next round.
Result.SpellKnown: {name} already knows {spell} at Rank {rank} - the book teaches nothing new.

Reroll.Hint: Spend 1 AI Favor to reroll this Check's d20, keeping everything else (p.61). Once per Check; not on a Natural 1.
Reroll.Superseded: Rerolled with AI Favor - the newer card has the result.
Reroll.Missing: What this roll used is gone (its Skill or target), so it can't be rerolled.
Reroll.NoFavor: {name} has no AI Favor left to spend.

Taunt.Success: Success — the Attack now targets you!
Taunt.FailedNotice: {name}'s Taunt fails — the attack is unchanged.
Taunt.AlreadyResolved: This Attack has already been resolved and can no longer be redirected.
Taunt.CannotTauntSelf: You're already the target of this Attack.
Taunt.NoAttacker: Could not find the attacking Mob for this card.
Taunt.NoTauntSkill: You don't have the Taunt Skill.
Taunt.NotArea: An Area Attack hits everyone in the area - it can't be Taunted onto one crawler.

Roll.EvadeMajorFail: Major Fail: this crawler takes extra damage equal to the current Floor Number and gains a Minor Injury Debuff after combat.
Roll.EvadeCriticalFail: Critical Fail: this crawler takes double damage and gains a Major Injury Debuff after combat.
Roll.AdvancementAtCap: Already at its Rank cap ({rank}) - no Check rolled.

Dialog.AreaAttackHint: One roll; damage hits everyone targeted (p.83)
Dialog.AdvantageAutoApplied: Advantage pre-selected — Nat 20/Amazing Success Evade bonus vs. this Mob.
Dialog.ChooseParentSkillBody: Which Skill or Spell are you attacking with, applying {name}?

TokenResolution.NoGMSelection: Select a token on the canvas first.
TokenResolution.NoActor: You have no owned token selected and no assigned character.

SpendStatPoints.Title: Spend Stat Points
SpendStatPoints.Hint: Each banked point buys +1 to one Stat's base value.
SpendStatPoints.HintMob: Each available point buys +1 to one Stat's base value. Available points are computed fresh from this Mob's Level and Tier, not banked over time.
SpendStatPoints.MobFormula: Level {level} x {statPointsPerLevel} points/Level, plus a base of {statPointsBase} in each Stat.
SpendStatPoints.Increment: Spend a point to increase this Stat by 1
SpendStatPoints.Decrement: Refund a point, decreasing this Stat by 1

Warning.DebuffBlocksAction: {name} has {debuff} and can't do that. Remove the Debuff to roll anyway.
Warning.PassiveNoCheck: {name} is a Passive Skill - it doesn't use Skill Checks.
Warning.RollNeedsOwner: This item has no owning Actor to roll for.
Warning.DamageEffectUntrained: {name} is untrained (Rank 0) and can't be applied as a Damage Effect.
Warning.DamageEffectNoParentSkill: You don't know any Skill or Spell that can use {name}.

LootBox.TakeHint: Give this item to {name}. You can also drag it onto any sheet you own.
LootBox.EmptyGM: Empty. Pick a tier and click Generate Loot, or drop items here.
LootBox.TakeFailed: {item} couldn't be given out, so it stayed in the box.
LootBox.NoCharacter: You have no assigned Character. Drag the item onto your sheet instead.
LootBox.NoGMOnline: A GM needs to be online to hand out loot.

Grind.SurplusBody: {name} ground {hours} more hour(s) than {skill} needed. Hours can't be banked on the same Skill, so apply them to another one.
Grind.PickPrompt: Which of {name}'s Skills gets the {hours} hour(s)?
Grind.NoTargets: {name} has no Skill that can take grinding hours right now. A Skill needs Rank 1 or more, must be below its Rank cap, and must be able to advance through use (not a Passive Spell).
Grind.ActorGone: The grinding character no longer exists.
Grind.LevelBody: {name}'s grinding hours have reached their Level: they gain a Level (now Level {level}). If they're the party's lowest Level, they gain 1d2 Levels instead (p.171) - the GM adds the extra.

MobAttack.Subtitle: To hit {difficulty}
MobAttack.FreeEvadeNote: Disadvantaged Attack: the target gets a free Evade Check. If it fails, they may still spend an Action to Evade again.

RoundEnd.Title: End of Round {round}
RoundEnd.Subtitle: Debuffs
RoundEnd.DotDigest: {name} - {debuff}: {raw} rolled, {final} after Resistances (DR bypassed), {slots} HB slot(s) lost
RoundEnd.DotWhileDying: {name} is Dying: {debuff} takes 1 off the countdown instead of dealing damage.
RoundEnd.FatalSaved: {name} passes the CON Check: {debuff} ends and its damage is avoided.
RoundEnd.FatalFailed: {name} fails the CON Check against fatal Debuff damage.
RoundEnd.RestoreHbBlocked: {name} can't be healed ({debuff}) - {source} restores no Health Bar slots.
RoundEnd.DyingHealed: {name} is healed and no longer Dying.

Blinded.Label: Blinded
Blinded.Effect: Roll all sight-based Skill Checks with Disadvantage.
Blinded.MobEffect: Sight-based Difficulties of this Mob (its Attacks, and usually its Evade) drop by 5.

BloodTrail.Label: Blood Trail
BloodTrail.MobEffect: 1d6+Floor damage, applied at end of round. Stackable.

Burned.Label: Burned
Burned.MobEffect: 1d10+Floor Fire damage, applied at end of round.

Drowning.Label: Drowning
Drowning.MobEffect: 1d6+Floor damage, applied at end of round.

Dying.Label: Dying
Dying.Effect: Can't act. CON Mod = rounds until death; further damage just ticks the countdown.

Enraged.Label: Enraged
Enraged.Effect: May only perform Attack and Move Actions.

Fatigued.Label: Fatigued
Fatigued.Effect: -1 penalty to all Checks; Move halved. Stackable.
Fatigued.MobEffect: -1 per stack to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties); Move halved.

Held.Label: Held
Held.Effect: Can't use Move Actions or take a Step. Attacks against you made with Advantage.

LongTermMajorInjury.Label: Long-Term Major Injury
LongTermMajorInjury.MobEffect: -5 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

LongTermMinorInjury.Label: Long-Term Minor Injury
LongTermMinorInjury.MobEffect: -2 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

MajorInjury.Label: Major Injury
MajorInjury.Effect: -5 penalty to all Checks. A 2nd Major Injury upgrades to Long-Term Major Injury.
MajorInjury.MobEffect: -5 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties). A 2nd Major Injury upgrades to Long-Term Major Injury.

MinorInjury.Label: Minor Injury
MinorInjury.Effect: -2 penalty to all Checks. A 2nd Minor Injury upgrades to Long-Term Minor Injury.
MinorInjury.MobEffect: -2 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties). A 2nd Minor Injury upgrades to Long-Term Minor Injury.

Poisoned.Label: Poisoned
Poisoned.MobEffect: 1d8+Floor Poison damage, applied at end of round. Stackable.

Queasy.Label: Queasy
Queasy.Effect: Next Action requiring a roll is made with Disadvantage.
Queasy.MobEffect: This Mob's next Attack Difficulty drops by 5; the target gets a free Evade Check.

Sepsis.Label: Sepsis
Sepsis.Effect: Gains Staggered; 1d10+Floor Poison damage/round until healed.
Sepsis.MobEffect: Gains Staggered; 1d10+Floor Poison damage, applied at end of round, until healed.

ShitFaced.Label: Shit-Faced
ShitFaced.MobEffect: All of this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties) drop by 5.

SoreAsShit.Label: Sore as Shit
SoreAsShit.MobEffect: -1 to this Mob's Difficulties (Evade, Attacks, Stat Difficulties).

Staggered.Label: Staggered
Staggered.Effect: Next Action can't be a Move; if it's an Attack, made with Disadvantage; can't take a 10ft Step.
Staggered.MobEffect: Next Action can't be a Move; if it's an Attack, its Difficulty drops by 5 (target gets a free Evade Check); can't take a 10ft Step.

Stunned.Label: Stunned
Stunned.MobEffect: The next Difficulty a crawler rolls against this Mob drops by 5 (if it's this Mob's Attack, the target also gets a free Evade Check).

TakeDown.Label: Take Down
TakeDown.Effect: Fall prone; Attacks against you made with Advantage.

Terrified.Label: Terrified
Terrified.Effect: Can't take Move Actions or 10ft Steps; Attacks made with Disadvantage.
Terrified.MobEffect: Can't take Move Actions or 10ft Steps; this Mob's Attack Difficulties drop by 5 (target gets a free Evade Check).

Woozy.Label: Woozy
Woozy.Effect: Can't add DEX Mod to Attack or Evade Checks.
Woozy.MobEffect: This Mob's Evade (and any DEX-based Attack) Difficulty doesn't include its DEX Mod.
